means.example-sentence: John left us in such a great hurry that he didn’t so much as say goodbye to us.
means.sentence-jp: ジョンは大急ぎで去ったので、私たちにさよならを言うことさえしなかった。

cloze.maskedText: John left us in such a great hurry that he didn’t so much as ____ goodbye to us.

notes: 同じ内容が without so much as doing で表されることもあり、その場合の doing は動名詞。
